summary: According to a small computer model rather than human tests, Sulfisoxazole Acetyl received a high score for liver risk and a low score for heart risk [M]. While there are no listed problems directly tied to this drug itself, two chemically similar drugs faced regulatory actions [3][4]. One similar drug, Sulfacarbamide, was taken off the market in Germany starting in 1988 due to blood problems and harm to the liver [3]. Another related drug, Sulfamethazine, was also removed from the German market beginning in 1992 [4].
